name: smokestack-cpu-game
note: the self-playing cart: three CPUs (Normal, Hard, Easy) on the large valley, every choice entered by pressing the pad's actions toward the highlighted plaque, card or board site; a full game ends with a legal winner inside the frame budget and both GPU hosts reach the same state hash and scores. Control: the run one frame short differs

name: smokestack-cpu-game-4p
note: four CPUs (Normal, Hard, Easy, Normal): a full four-player game ends with a legal winner, both GPU hosts agree. Control: the run one frame short differs

name: smokestack-cpu-game-2p
note: two CPUs (Hard, Easy) on the small valley: a full two-player game ends with a legal winner, both GPU hosts agree. Control: the run one frame short differs

name: smokestack-idle-seat
note: a CPU (Normal) first and a person who never touches the pad (the how-to-play card still up): the CPU makes its opening bid under the card and the game waits for the person. Control: the person sits first instead, the idle seat is to move, and nothing is played (0 decisions)

name: smokestack-newcomer
note: a newcomer on one pad against CPU Easy, using only what the screen offers: the confirm the how-to-play card and every prompt name, every 26 frames, which closes the card and then takes whatever the highlighted plaque, card or board site offers; a full game ends inside the budget (every move legal by construction: only legal choices are lit). Control: the same presses on the back action, which the prompts offer only to take a tile back, so no game is played
